# Generated catalog (do not edit)

Files here are written by `npm run content:sync` from `data/*.csv`.

- `photographs.json` — captured page payloads for `loadCapturedWork()`
- `series.json` — minimal series pages when no `content/work/series/<slug>.js`
- `products.json` — product shelf metadata and bundle members

Edit source: [`data/`](../../data/README.md).
